// 창·도구 설명·사용 규칙·대화창 요약 줄에 쓰는 문구. 설정 language(한국어 / English)로 고른다.
// 탭 이름·단계 문구처럼 에이전트가 쓴 내용은 번역하지 않는다(사용 규칙이 에이전트에게 어느 언어로 쓸지 알려 준다).

export type Lang = 'ko' | 'en'
export const LANGUAGES = ['한국어', 'English'] as const
export const toLang = (value: unknown): Lang => (value === 'English' ? 'en' : 'ko')

const GUIDE_EN = [
  '# notes (side-pane notes for the user)',
  'The user follows the progress of your work in the notes side pane, so they never have to scroll back through the conversation.',
  '',
  '## When to create a tab: if any of these apply, create the tab with notes_write before your first action (tool call)',
  '- There are 2 or more things to do, including requests where the user spelled out the steps (e.g. "fix A, test it, then reply"). Copy those steps into items as given.',
  '- The work leaves a lasting result: editing files, deploying or publishing, posting to Slack, a wiki or JIRA.',
  '- Even a research or check request counts if it ends by handing the user a decision or options (plan A/B/C). Write the research steps plus "waiting for the user\'s decision" as items.',
  '- You are following a skill procedure through several steps.',
  'Skip notes for: a question answered with one lookup, small talk, or a request for an explanation.',
  '',
  '## How to write',
  '- Name the tab yourself with a short English name (30 characters or fewer) that makes the work easy to recognize. For a follow-up request on the same work, append to the existing tab with add_items instead of creating a new one.',
  '- Check each step with notes_check as soon as you finish it. Do not check several at once later.',
  '- Once the finish line or acceptance criteria are clear, write them in done_when.',
  '- Put what the user must see (decisions, caveats, confirmations you handed to the user, remaining work such as a pending commit or push) in memo.',
  '- memo is for reference, not for tasks. Put each entry on its own line. Things to do go in items, not memo.',
  '- When the plan changes, rewrite the steps with items.',
  '- When a step is blocked (permissions, errors) or waiting for the user or an outside answer, mark it with notes_status as blocked / waiting and give the reason (note). Once the user unblocks it or the answer arrives, leave status: clear with what was done (note). That note shows right under the step.',
  '- Collect work products such as commits, PRs, file paths and links in the results section with add_results. Do not mix them into memo.',
  '- The pane does not number steps. If order matters, number them yourself in the text (e.g. "1. ...", sub-steps "1-1. ..."). Decision or question steps may use a tag such as [Decision] instead of a number. If you number steps, keep them sequential from 1 within the tab, with no gaps or duplicates.',
  '- #N in notes_read results is the position number (the value you pass to notes_check) and may differ from any number in the step text.',
  '- When the user moves to a different topic, leave the existing tabs as they are and create a new tab.',
  '- When the user asks about earlier work ("where were we with that?"), call notes_read first and then answer.',
  '- Delete a tab (notes_close) only when the user wants it cleaned up.',
].join('\n')
